title: Neuberger Musuem of Art

services.name: Tours and Groups
services.desc: The Neuberger Museum of Art’s NEU Kids Art Access Program fills an educational gap by providing field trips to the museum for close to 2,000 local children each year. This includes waived admissions, round-trip school bus transportation, lunch, and guided tours with talented docents who bring the galleries to life!
